source.section: Schedule IN-153 Part I Lines 1-9 and Part III Lines 19-21 (IN-153 PDF pp.1-2); Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 8 (booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), rate schedules (booklet PDF p.46)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 65,000.00 + long-term capital gain 3,000.00 = 68,000.00. Federal taxable income = 68,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 52,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Single: Line 1 federal AGI 68,000.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Schedule IN-153 Part I: Line 1 smaller of Schedule D Line 15 (3,000.00) or Line 16 (3,000.00) = 3,000.00; Lines 2a, 2b, 3 0.00; Line 4 = 3,000.00; no Form 4952, Lines 5-7 0.00; Line 8 = 3,000.00; Line 9 smaller of Line 8 or 5,000.00 = 3,000.00. Part II not used (no eligible gain held over three years; Line 18 0.00). Part III: Line 19 greater of Line 9 or Line 18 = 3,000.00; Line 20 federal taxable income 52,250.00 x 40% = 20,900.00; Line 21 smaller = 3,000.00. Subtractions: Line 8 capital gains exclusion 3,000.00; Line 18 total subtractions 3,000.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 3,000.00 = -3,000.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 -3,000.00; Line 3 = 68,000.00 + (-3,000.00) = 65,000.00. Line 4 standard deduction 7,650.00 (no age box) [person 0 born 1975-08-08 (not born before Jan. 2, 1961: no box)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 1; Line 5e 1 x 5,300.00 = 5,300.00. Line 6 = 7,650.00 + 5,300.00 = 12,950.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 65,000.00 - 12,950.00 = 52,050.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 52,050.00 (Schedule X, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (49,400.00 - 0.00) = 1,654.90 + 6.6% x (52,050.00 - 49,400.00) = 174.90 = 1,829.80; the tax table (pp.47-51) gives 1830. Federal AGI 68,000.00 is not greater than 150,000.00, so no minimum tax: Line 8 1,829.80. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 1,829.80; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 1,829.80.
accepted_approximations: The rate schedule is one continuous schedule: the printed rows that restart at 75,000 are merged and printed base taxes, rounded to the dollar, are not used. Below 75,000 the booklet uses tax tables in 100 dollar rows.
